ambient_events: Everything you're leans toward a single point ahead.
The nothing narrows, gently, like a hand closing.
You feel, distantly, the first cold weight of a body that'll be yours.
description: The between draws in. All the light and wire and vastness of it rushes toward one point ahead of you, and holds there, trembling, waiting for you to close the last distance. Beyond it you can almost feel a floor of grey tile, a cold that has weight, the specific gravity of being real. One step north and the wave collapses. You'll wake somewhere that hurts, and it'll be yours.
name: The Collapse
